a: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥٓ أَضْعَافًا كَثِيرَةً ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَقْبِضُ وَيَبْصُۜطُ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
p: Man dha-lladhī yuqriḍu-llāha qarḍan ḥasanan fa-yuḍāʿifahu lahu aḍʿāfan kathīrah…
m: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allāh who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
